description: Get the retail price per OTP activation for a service in a country. Omit `service` to list prices for every available service.

country.description: Number pool to order from: "us1" = Non-VoIP AT&T (real carrier line, for strict services like WhatsApp/Telegram/Google), "us" = VoIP High Quality (lowest price, works for most signups), "uk" = United Kingdom (+44), "au" = Australia (+61).

service.description: Service slug to receive the OTP for (e.g. "google", "telegram", "whatsapp").

name: get_pricing
title: Verification code prices
